name: dynobase
description: Query DynamoDB from Claude through the Dynobase desktop app. Read-only unless you allow writes.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to the MCP server built into Dynobase 3.0 and later, the desktop client for Amazon DynamoDB. Claude can list your tables, read their schemas and run queries, scans and PartiQL SELECTs through the AWS profiles Dynobase has loaded. Your AWS credentials stay in Dynobase. Write tools only work after you turn on Allow writes in Dynobase.

Requires Dynobase, open, with Settings → AI → MCP server turned on. The extension reads the port and token from Dynobase's settings, so you don't need to enter them. Dynobase is a paid app with a 7-day free trial.

token.title: Token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty to use the token saved in Dynobase's settings. Otherwise copy it from Dynobase → Settings → AI → MCP server.

url.title: MCP URL (optional)
url.description: Leave empty to use the port saved in Dynobase's settings (http://127.0.0.1:41961/mcp unless you changed it).

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: Lists loaded profiles with their regions and table names

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Lists the table names of one profile

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Returns the full DescribeTable output plus TTL

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Returns one page of a Scan

tools.name: query
tools.description: Returns one page of a Query

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Returns one item by primary key

tools.name: partiql
tools.description: Runs one PartiQL statement, SELECT only unless writes are allowed

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Says which index a key condition would use, and whether it's a Query or a Scan

tools.name: put_item
tools.description: Writes an item (only when Allow writes is on)

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Updates an item (only when Allow writes is on)

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Deletes an item (only when Allow writes is on)

tools.name: batch_write
tools.description: Writes or deletes up to 25 items (only when Allow writes is on)
